Charge derivative/profile storage to a configured reservation; read_to_limit visibly stops at that quota.

Reuse area.py RFC7946/recognizedCRS84 rule; late conflicting CRS revokes ALL tentative displays/packages.

steps.action: Officer approves one file layout/destination/frame through streamed-prefix recipe authority.

the first while claiming source-wide uniqueness. Drift/rejected rows do not stop other valid complete parts.

Use engine.waitForDrawn; cap drawn features, switch to bounded viewport pages, never500000 meshes.
Scene-only raw slot join is not an end-to-end package proof; use actual package candidates.

notes: 250 packages appear as250 immutable package pins plus up to500000 exact target rows, not250 manual approvals.

List paged/searchable; counts from stored rows; officer includes/excludes groups, inspects exceptions.

job.authority: Existing jobs/usp_job_metadata/usp_job_attempts and dispatcher; no second queue.
job.operation: Extend intake-draft with registered versioned proved-part input, alongside its bounded-file input.
job.granularity: Per file: streaming-vector/profile/mapping jobs. Per PACKAGE part: intake-draft job.
idempotency: Pin usp_intake_items.plan_ref once: sourceId/revision/SHA,reader,approved planHash,destination frame.
Deterministic UUID/jobId, unique import_packages.operation_key; atomic result_ref under part lock.
Same part/epoch makes one package across crashes. Changed layout is explicit correction, not second draft.
usp_intake_parts PK(item_id,part_index) guards authority; never overwrite result for another epoch.
orderAndPressure: Sequential reader, deterministic cuts in global order. Raw publication watermark preserves order.
At most8 unfinished draft jobs/file; published candidates waiting for review do not occupy these8 slots.
Release next only when draft consumer/storage reservation fits; confirmation can wait until EOF.
Byte stream pauses when its bounded reservation/look-ahead fills; no ever-growing RAM queue.
Browser draw pressure is independent: stored candidates wait, client pulls next only after engine draw receipt.
While layout waits, raw parts use reserved disk; at quota, visible read_to_limit, no dropped remainder.
failureAndResume: Bad feature stays in raw ledger; failed package part quarantined with locator/code, later parts continue.
File-integrity, source/access or layout-pin failure stops ALL dependent readiness, not merely one part.
Transient failures: fenced180s lease/30s heartbeat/three attempts; expired attempt cannot publish.
Resume scans part/result refs, returns existing package on replay, queues only absent/nonterminal parts.
Raw reader still replays from zero after crash; changing to byte-seek cursor is not needed for the first build.
Malformed JSON cannot continue from guessed boundary; retain prefix and unknown remainder.

identity.sourceFeatureIndex: Zero-based whole-original index from raw payload; never part-local or accepted-only.

identity.locator: sourceId/revision/SHA,global index,[byteStart,byteEnd),rawSha256; copied to feature history.
identity.extract: Range-read original feature, verify rawSha256/key, return exact properties substring/whitespace.

existingConsidered: usp_intake_parts.locator/counts/result_ref: package-part byte/record membership, pins and package ref (:45-64).

officerLimitsThatStay: We can retain up to7 GiB through the configured large-upload profile; this GeoJSON reader accepts up to1 GB.
This reader stops at500000 features; anything unread stays retained and is counted as an unknown remainder.
Each package is at most16 MiB and2000 features,100000 vertices total and10000 per feature.
This local area is at most50 km across/from its origin; a part outside it needs a placement decision.
A serialized normalizer input is at most20 MiB; complex geometry may produce more than250 packages.
Each raw feature is at most1 MiB; raw parts512 KiB/100 records, mapped parts256 KiB/100 records.
Metadata64 KiB/32 fields,nesting64; profile64 paths/64 KiB,100 displayed quarantine locators remain.
1 MiB feature ceiling does not override tighter part serialization bounds; oversized output is a visible hold.
A dense check exceeding20000 pairs or bounded qualified context stops with a question; no partial clean verdict.
Only supported source polygons/complete literal keys are ready; missing CRS, drift or duplicates are questions.
Reader/profile/mapping deadlines are finite and shown; current10/12/12 minutes must be qualified/reconfigured.
552 features/s on the small control is NOT evidence500000 features finishes inside the current10 minutes.
Upload receipts currently have lifetime caps128 v1/8 v2; readers/mapping/profile128, active2/1/1 globally.
These lifetime caps stay for this one-file build; reaching one refuses admission, it never deletes history.
Upload parts8 MiB, one writer/receipt, three attempts,180s lease; storage reservation is required.
Snapshots select at most100 targets,1000 dependency records/features and2000 sources; cards arrive in turn.
Exact excerpt remains<=16000 characters; large properties may not fit a card extract and will be held.
Private sources and original ranges stay private; restricted data never reaches a provider.
No heights, floors, units, rights, ownership, geometry qualification or official parcel identifiers are invented.
